# Design System — Extended

> Scope: static element samples from the captured region. Names beginning with `measured-` identify exact source measurements, not global design rules. In a mix, these are unblended source references.

## Overview

**Identity:** GitHub
**Summary:** A dark-themed, modern developer platform landing page design system built around Primer components, rich ambient gradients, and crisp high-contrast typography.
**Density:** balanced
**Layout philosophy:** Dark immersive canvas featuring centered hero messaging, high-contrast action elements, glowing atmospheric backdrops, and structured technical product showcases.

### Tone and personality

- modern
- developer-focused
- authoritative
- innovative
- technical
- sleek
- dark-mode-first
- sophisticated

## Key Rules

### Do

- Use vibrant accent green (rgb(8, 135, 43)) strictly for primary sign-up CTAs.
- Maintain high contrast white typography against dark rgb(13, 17, 23) canvas surfaces.
- Utilize 6px border radii on buttons and 8px on inputs for consistent control shapes.

### Don't

- Do not use light background panels for core layout sections.
- Avoid high-contrast heavy drop shadows; rely on ambient backdrop glows instead.

## Known Gaps

- `NO_HOVER_STATES`: Hover, focus, and pressed states were not recorded from static evidence. (source: web_1)
- `UNOBSERVED_FOOTER`: Footer element was not captured within the static viewport bounds. (source: web_1)
- `media-content-excluded`: Capture targets static branding: media downloads and playback are excluded. Existing video boxes and available posters are retained; video frames, motion and media-dependent content are not evidence of the design system. (source: web_1)
- `capture-sections`: The regional image combines viewport photographs taken at different times. Sticky elements are shown in document flow and fixed overlays at most once; original styles are restored before measurement. CSS transitions are completed for photographs; script-driven animation states can differ between sections. Video content is excluded. (source: web_1)
- `css-evidence-sampled`: CSS custom properties and responsive rules are a bounded sample; computed styles describe the captured region. (source: web_1)
- `capture-static-state`: The capture covers the initial page region with CSS animations disabled for the screenshot; later interactions and motion states were not observed. (source: web_1)
- `capture-height-truncated`: The page exceeded the screenshot height limit; lower-page evidence may be missing. (source: web_1)
- `blocked-subresources`: Some subresources were blocked by public-network safety validation. (source: web_1)
- `model-roles-inferred`: Model-assigned roles and recipes are interpretations, even when their values appear in CSS. Only measured- entries are linked to exact sampled elements; interaction states were not exercised. (source: web_1)
- `model-typography-omitted`: The model returned unmeasured typography roles. Element-scoped measurements are supplied below; global role assignments remain unverified. (source: web_1)
- `measurement-scope`: Measurements are bounded element samples from one static viewport. CSS frequencies and sample categories do not establish global roles, a base spacing unit, mobile behavior or unvisited interaction states. (source: web_1)
- `footer-not-observed`: No footer was present in the sampled region; footer components are not documented as observed. (source: web_1)
- `measurement-categories-missing`: No sampled measurements for: card. Inspect these elements separately if needed. (source: web_1)

- `capture-sections`: The regional image combines viewport photographs taken at different times. Sticky elements are shown in document flow and fixed overlays at most once; original styles are restored before measurement. CSS transitions are completed for photographs; script-driven animation states can differ between sections. Video content is excluded. (source: web_1)
- `css-evidence-sampled`: CSS custom properties and responsive rules are a bounded sample; computed styles describe the captured region. (source: web_1)
- `capture-static-state`: The capture covers the initial page region with CSS animations disabled for the screenshot; later interactions and motion states were not observed. (source: web_1)
- `capture-height-truncated`: The page exceeded the screenshot height limit; lower-page evidence may be missing. (source: web_1)
- `blocked-subresources`: Some subresources were blocked by public-network safety validation. (source: web_1)
- `model-roles-inferred`: Model-assigned roles and recipes are interpretations, even when their values appear in CSS. Only measured- entries are linked to exact sampled elements; interaction states were not exercised. (source: web_1)
